title: Berkeley Rent Ordinance rent control coverage
requirement: Rent increases are controlled only for fully covered units: most multifamily units built before 1980, pre-1996 single-family tenancies, and rooming houses. Partially covered and exempt units are not rent controlled.
coverage_conditions: Fully covered: multifamily units built before 1980, single-family homes with tenancies that began before 1996, and rooming houses. New construction certified after June 1980, post-1996 single-family tenancies, condominiums and certain subsidized units are not rent controlled.

conditions.text: units with Section 202 or Section 811 subsidies, or project-based Section 8 in a project with a HUD-insured mortgage

applicability.per_tenancy: Single-family home tenancies beginning on or after January 1, 1996; tenancy where the owner shares a kitchen or bath; tenancies started after Nov 7, 2018 where one unit is an ADU and either unit is owner-occupied.

exemptions: Golden Duplex (owner-occupied duplex on Dec 31, 1979); owner-shared kitchen or bath; post-Nov 7, 2018 ADU tenancies with an owner-occupied unit; university rental units such as dormitories; nonprofit cooperatives.

title: Berkeley Rent Ordinance just cause for eviction coverage
requirement: A landlord may end a tenancy only for just cause in units covered by the Berkeley Rent Ordinance, which include fully and partially covered units; exempt units are not covered.
coverage_conditions: Just cause applies to fully and partially covered units: multifamily units built before 1980, most single-family homes and condominiums, and certain subsidized units.

applicability.per_tenancy: Tenancy where the owner shares a kitchen or bath and lived on the property when the tenancy started; tenancies started after Nov 7, 2018 where one unit is an ADU and either unit is owner-occupied; university rental units such as dormitories.

title: Berkeley Rent Ordinance security deposit interest coverage
requirement: A landlord must pay interest on security deposits for units covered by the Berkeley Rent Ordinance, including fully and partially covered units; exempt units are not covered.
coverage_conditions: Security deposit interest applies to fully and partially covered units, but not to exempt units such as the Golden Duplex, owner-shared units, post-2018 ADU tenancies, dormitories and nonprofit cooperatives.
